content: Jinwun Hanjia, Falisai Kunlai Kheilazho
Ingiedene Ersa olon kunlade, tujiladene kieliewo,
"Jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunla Musani guijinyi jieshi gieku qienli bareizho.
Ingiese hhela tande sughasei ta man zunjizhi giema, hhelai giekuni bu dagha. Hhela sughasanne ulie giene.
Hhela banlasan gundu danzilani kunlai dalou jiere jiedene goyala nie kha ghurunneliuzhe ulie gojiolughane.
Hhela giesan soyuji shiqinlane kunlade uzheghane giezhi giezho. Hhela zhoku jinwun xiaxiani giezhi fugiedaghazho. Jienni sasuiye giezhi fududaghazho.
Hhela xini shanxide, huitanni undu wizide soukude xiqi wo.
Giedoude kunla hhelade kielien asazhi loushi giezhi urukude xiqi wo.
Ta kunlai goyane loushi giezhi bu urugha, tande zi niekozi loushi wo, ta manshi gaijiu wo.
Zemin jieredu kunni ada giezhi bu uru, tande zi niekozi ada wo, hheshi asiman jieredu ada wo.
Ta kunlai goyane shifu giezhi bu urugha. Tande zi niekozi shifu wo, hheshi Mexiha wo.
Tai dunda zui fugienishi tande hoji danlakuni wo.
Kien goyane undudaghase boghonidaghane. Goyane boghonidaghase undudaghane."
"Ta jiazhon giesan jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunlade gou widawo! Ta kunlade asiman gojiani wijienyi khazhi goyalane ese orozho, orone giechen kunlaiye ese oroghazho."

"Ta jiazhon giesan jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunlade gou widawo! Ta nie kunyi jiopaidene oroghane giezhi zemin haini yo baraghane. Hhei jiopaidene oroghadene dozoheini kun gholughazhi tanse da olon doghunshighane."
"Ta mo udurusan sugholade gou widawo! Ta kieliese mechii zhiizhi fayen giese yama ulie sananema, mechii antanni zhiizhi fayen giese kieliendene kuru giezho.
Sughotu guazila, alinieshi zhunyoni wo? Antan onu? Antanni zhiguishighasan mechi wo?
Ta pse kieliese sidagha gieku teizini zhiizhi fayen giese yama ulie sananema, sidagha gieku teizi jieredu dunxilai zhiizhi fayen giese kieliendene kuru giezho.
Sughola, daoji mure zhunyo onu mureni zhiguishighaku sidagha gieku teizi zhunyo wo?
Ingiese kien sidagha gieku teizini zhiizhi fayen giese sidagha gieku teizi, sidagha gieku teizi jiereshiku dunxilani man zhiizhi fayen giezho;
Kien mechii zhiizhi fayen giese mechi sudoro sousan Hudai zhiizhi fayen giezho.
Kien asimanyi zhiizhi fayen giese Hudai baozo, baozo jiere sousan Hudai zhiizhi fayen giezho."

"Ta jiazhon giesan jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunlade gou widawo! Ta bohe, huajio, ziranlasene Hudade ushirei ogizhoma, guijin jieredu gundande gieku, ubali xiiku, kekaoni enezighan genjia zhunyoni ulie giene. Enelai ta indan giekui wo, psedulaiye ulie giekui pusho.
Ta mo udurusan sughola, ta meiyen ghugheini liizhi khizheghane, lotoni hulun yenjine."
"Ta jiazhon giesan jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunlade gou widawo! Ta beizi, jiezilai mienzii wagha arughazhoma, sudoroni tanxin gieku, lon giekula duruzho.
Ta sughotu Falisai kunla, xien beizi sudorodui waghazhi arugha, mienziye arune."
"Ta jiazhon giesan jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunlade gou widawo! Ta fenshua giesan mezai xianli, ghadanese uzhese gou wo, sudoro fugusan kunyi yasun, yanyanji zannanni duruzho.
Taiye kunla mienzise uzhese gou wo, sudorotai jiazhon gieku, mouxienni duruzho."
"Ta jiazhon giesan jinwun hanjia, Falisai kunlade gou widawo! Ta xienzhilai mezai giezho, gou kunni jilaku peizii giezhi mezai goudaghadene
'Xienrenlane hhe xienzide bijien bizhoshi xienzhii chusunyi xienrenlarene hhantu ulie usurughane.' giezhi kieliezho.
Ingiezhi ta xienzhilani alasan kunlai houdei bikui zhenmin giezho.
Ta xienrenlane zuini giezhi baraghale echi!
Ta enezighan moghei, du mogheini zhunzhugha. Ta matugie dozoheini faikuse andane?

Ingiese bi xienzhi, aghelitu, jinwun hanjialai tai enende peizhi ireghane. Ta niezhanlai alane, niezhanlai shizijia jiere ghadane, pse niezhanlai huitande mabienzighala eghine, ene chenshise touzhi hhe chenshide echighane.
Ingiese gou kun Hhabise qiizhi izhi dajienji sidagha gieku teizi dunda alasan Balajiani kewon Sajialiyai zuini guide kurutula soyuji gou kunla usurusan chusunni guini man tai jiere ireghane.
Bi tande shuhua kielieye, ene guini man ene idai kunlai jiere ireghane."
Yelusalende Oluzhi Shonholozho
"Yelusalen, Yelusalen! Peizhi ireghasan xienzhilai tashidazhi alasan chenshiya, bi chii kesilani gieduifa muji tigha zhunzhughalane siban doura hhantulaghaku mutun hhantulaghane giese ta duran uwo.
Uzhe, chii gie hontan gholuzhi chade zinie hontan feiliene.
Bi chade kielieye, chi 'Ezhanni niereghala iresan kunni doulandu.' giezhi kielietula mii pse chanla dane."
